items.title: State Street and Van Lanschot Kempen launch small-cap active ETF duo
items.summary: State Street Investment Management and Van Lanschot Kempen Investment Management have introduced two active exchange-traded funds focused on US and European small-cap equities.

items.title: PPF 7800 index surplus falls to £280.7bn in October
items.summary: The aggregate funding position of schemes in the Pension Protection Fund index decreased during October as liabilities rose faster than assets.

items.title: PremFina partners with digital car insurance brand Boom
items.summary: Premium finance provider PremFina has entered into a partnership with car insurance digital brand Boom, an appointed representative of Dayinsure.

items.title: Optio acquires Norwegian underwriting business SAFE Forsikring
items.summary: London-based specialty MGA Optio Group has expanded its Nordic operations and aquaculture capabilities by acquiring Norwegian underwriting business SAFE Forsikring.

items.title: EQ Investors and Nordea launch sustainable multi-asset funds
items.summary: EQ Investors and Nordea Asset Management have partnered to introduce two sustainable multi-asset funds with a 0.35% ongoing charge figure.

items.title: Aspect MGA uses AI linguistic model to analyse broker submissions
items.summary: Aspect MGA is using a forensic linguistic AI model to assess commercial property submission text and inform underwriting decisions.
